newsitem.title: UK: BICC receives 92.7 pct take-up on cash call.
newsitem.headline: BICC receives 92.7 pct take-up on cash call.

text.p: BICC Plc said on Friday it has received acceptances of 92.7 percent of the 64.5 million new ordinary shares offered to shareholders in September.

The British construction and engineering group made a 170 million stg cash call to investors on September 19 in a 2-for-11 rights issue of new shares at 270 pence per share to fund investment opportunities.
The company said at that time that it planned to invest about 140 million stg in optical fibres, Brand-Rex data communications cables, and high voltage cabling.
An added 40 million was earmarked for the Asia-Pacific, as well as 35 million for equity investment in infrastructure projects in Britain and abroad.
